t: Section 106(k)(1)(H) of title 49, United States Code, is amended to read as follows:“(H) $3,692,555,464 for the period beginning on October 1, 2011, and ending on February 17, 2012.”.

fable.w: This section only amends a funding authorization amount for a specified period in title 49. There is no tempting reading here: it involves no consultation, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue, and no party outside the federal government takes part in any federal decision.
fable.s: $3,692,555,464 for the period beginning on October 1, 2011, and ending on February 17, 2012.
